notes:
- 完成消息检索 P0＋P1：多关键词复用加密 FTS 索引和统一规范化，返回命中附近原文；跨账号统一排序、显式时间排序和覆盖状态；新增复合检索与批量上下文工具，合并重复记录、关联授权范围内的引用原文，并独立执行记录/字节/token 预算。
- Implement retrieval P0/P1: reuse encrypted FTS with normalized literal verification and match-centered snippets; merge ranked candidates across accounts with explicit time ordering and coverage. Add composite retrieval and deduplicated batch context, authorized quote links, and independent record/byte/token budgets.
- WechatX Harness 为已知 OpenAI 模型接入离线 tokenizer，其他模型使用 Unicode 估算及返回用量校准，预留输出和工具空间，保持完整轮次裁剪。P2 语义索引与 P3 摘要压缩仍待后续实施。
- Add offline tokenization for known OpenAI models, Unicode estimates and returned-usage calibration for other custom API models, with answer/tool headroom and complete-turn trimming. Semantic indexing (P2) and summary compression (P3) remain planned.
- 修复 DeepSeek Harness 实时事件把系统提示、开发者指令和工具结果误显示为模型回答的问题；对话只接收用户消息与模型正文，处理过程仅显示状态与耗时。
- Fix DeepSeek Harness live events exposing system/developer prompts and tool results as assistant replies. Only user messages and assistant text become chat bubbles; progress shows status and timing only.
